items.title: Spanish PM and rivals rally supporters in final pitch for votes
items.description: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez wants to defy the polls, and his main rivals accuse him of not telling the truth and of "betrayal".

items.title: Zelensky criticises 'strange' Trump-Putin friendship in BBC interview
items.description: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is not pushing Russia hard enough in peace talks to end the war.

items.title: Weary of war but with no sign of backing down, Kyiv faces another punishing winter
items.description: Ukraine settles in for another devastating winter as the questions persists: how will it all end?

items.title: 'We couldn't give up that easily': Marching bands scramble to cover costs after Thanksgiving parade rearranged
items.description: Stormy weather in New York City prompted organisers to push back the Macy's parade by two days - leaving some musicians stuck.

items.title: Brazil pushes back on Macron calling its meat 'doped'
items.description: France's president made the comment while speaking to French farming representatives, months after the EU banned Brazil beef and poultry products.

items.title: 'Poison seller' Kenneth Law apologises in court to the families of his victims
items.description: The Canadian man, who pleaded guilty to 14 counts of aiding and abetting suicide earlier this year, said he was remorseful for his actions.

items.title: Capsized tanker carrying 7,000 tonnes of diesel to be towed away from Ibiza
items.description: There are fears of a major oil spillage off Ibiza but the ship's fuel tanks are so far intact.

items.title: Millions of wives in South Asia unprotected from marital rape - study
items.description: More than 100 countries have outlawed marital rape, but a large part of South Asia has not.

items.title: Canada's top court largely upholds Quebec ban on religious symbols for public servants
items.description: The law faced legal challenges from a range of groups, including female Muslim, Sikh and Catholic teachers, who argued it violated their fundamental rights.

items.title: Italy's former police chief rejected mafia inquiry allegations before death
items.description: The contents of an eight-page letter by Gianni De Gennaro have been revealed days after his body was found at his Tuscany home.

items.title: Rare turtles found inside baggage at Amsterdam airport
items.description: The endangered reptiles were bound with duct tape to prevent them moving, officials say.

items.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader convicted over further 123 deaths
items.description: Paul Mackenzie is found guilty of killing his followers, weeks after being jailed for the mass murder of children.

claude-code.name: seamless
claude-code.description: Local-first shared memory and task coordination for AI coding agents. One Go binary, MCP server, markdown files you own. Hooks for Claude Code and Codex CLI (and their desktop apps).

claude-code.name: roblox-brain
claude-code.description: The Roblox Studio knowledge your coding agent is missing. Skill library for Roblox Studio game development.

claude-code.name: orca
claude-code.description: Orca lets you run a fleet of bots with your own subscription (e.g. Claude Code, Grok, Agy, Codex). Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

claude-code.name: weather-mcp
claude-code.description: Free, open-source MCP server giving AI assistants 17 weather tools — a one-call weather summary plus forecasts, alerts, air quality, marine, radar, lightning, rivers, wildfires, and historical data back to 1940. Ask by city name or coordinates. Built on free public APIs (NOAA, Open-Meteo). No API keys, no signup.

claude-code.name: applied-ai-toolkit
claude-code.description: Working parts from my production AI work. A Claude API gateway with spending caps, prompt evals with a red-team runner, security checks for LLM apps and websites, n8n templates, and nine small apps, five of them with live demos. TypeScript, Python and PHP, all tested offline in CI.
